player_prompt.intro:
Ngeye Mwana {player_id} mu **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tambulisa mviringo wako kama **[macro  micro]** (nambari mbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = ni mini-bodi nini ulezi mu
• *micro* = ni mraba nini ndani ya mini-bodi ile
Mfano `[7 8]` ➜ weka alama yako mu mini-bodi 7, mraba 8, na
forsa mpingani wako alezi mu mini-bodi 8 inayofuata.

Ngeye `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tshikandakanda etshi tshidi ne bua kuikala mu mushindu wa [macro micro] muikale ne nimero 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Bintu bionso bidi ne bua kuikala pankatshi pa 0 ne 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Mikebelu ya mikese, mulongo anyi dikosa ki mmikumbane to.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Muena manaya udi ne bua kunanga mu tshisanji tshikuabu.

next_board.any: tshiamu tshia mikese ya bungi (micro board)

game_action.played: Mchezaji {player_id} alezi mu mini-bodi {macro_idx}, mraba {micro_idx} (safu {row}, safu wima {col}). Mchezaji {opponent_id} lazima alezi sasa mu {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Muena manaya {player_id} udi upeta mukanda wa Ultimate Tic Tac Toe! (mu tshiena Greke: "Tic-tac-toe" anyi "Mutshipu munene")
outcome.draw: Tshimfuanyi etshi tshidi tshipatula bipeta bibi!
